adapter_direct_enabled.description: Enable adapter-direct routing; rejects an external proxy endpoint and overrides transport, network and address.

adapter_direct_protocol.description: Select ENH or ENS for adapter-direct routing. Omitted values use ENH; an old proxy profile can supply the selector until explicitly persisted.

adapter_direct_address.description: Adapter endpoint or serial device path. Trim whitespace and the scheme; a serial protocol prefix must agree with the selector.

proxy_listen_addr.description: Gateway-integrated proxy listener address. Empty disables it; a configured listener requires gateway flag support.

transport.description: Transport input before adapter-direct or proxy overrides.

network.description: Network input before adapter-direct or proxy overrides.

address.description: Address input before adapter-direct or proxy overrides.

proxy_profile.description: External proxy profile, disabled, ENH or ENS. Selects effective transport and address; legacy adapter-direct configuration is migrated in memory.

proxy_endpoint.description: External proxy endpoint, required for an active external proxy profile and forbidden with adapter-direct mode.

host.description: Host label used only in logged HTTP URLs. Does not select the listener bind address.

http_port.description: HTTP listener port. Ingress is available on the declared Ingress port only.

graphql_path.description: GraphQL route. Adds a leading slash and derives the default subscription route from it.

subscription_path.description: Subscription route. Adds a leading slash; the default route follows a changed GraphQL route.

mcp_path.description: MCP HTTP route; the wrapper adds a leading slash when absent.

mdns.description: Enable or disable gateway mDNS advertisement.

broadcast.description: Enable or disable gateway broadcast handling.

source_addr.description: Auto delegates source selection to the gateway. Explicit values use the ebusd-compatible source flag for that transport, otherwise require validate-only startup override support.

scan_request_timeout.description: Gateway scan request timeout; empty values use 400ms.

adapter_mux_idle_release_grace.description: Adapter-mux idle release grace; positive whole ms or s only.

adapter_mux_max_ownership_duration.description: Adapter-mux maximum continuous bus ownership duration; positive whole ms or s only.

adapter_mux_read_timeout.description: Adapter-mux read timeout; positive whole ms or s only. Independent of read_timeout.

observe_first_enabled.description: Gateway observe-first switch; missing values use true.

passive_state_direct_apply.description: Gateway passive state direct-apply switch; missing values use true.

passive_config_direct_apply.description: Gateway passive configuration direct-apply switch; missing values use false.

external_write_policy.description: Gateway external write policy; missing values use record_only.

enable_static_seed_table.description: Request the static seed table. Passed only when supported; an unsupported enabled request logs a warning.

v8_classifier_mode.description: Classifier mode, off, shadow or enforce; exported through the gateway environment. Missing values use enforce.

eebus_enabled.description: Enable the eeBUS argument bundle after validation and gateway support checks; pairing remains closed.

eebus_listen_port.description: eeBUS listener port, validated from 1 through 65535 when enabled.

eebus_interface.description: One explicit interface; validated and used for the gateway interface argument and stable machine identity derivation.

eebus_subnets.description: Nonempty prefix list, trimmed before the enabled eeBUS bundle is emitted.

eebus_discovery_enabled.description: Boolean discovery control emitted with the enabled eeBUS bundle.

eebus_remote_ski_allowlist.description: Optional comma-separated remote SKI allowlist; every entry must be 40 hexadecimal characters.

modbus_tcp_enabled.description: Enable validated Modbus TCP configuration. Select the scalar endpoint file or the endpoints document; disabled configuration emits no Modbus arguments.

modbus_tcp_endpoint.description: Scalar Modbus TCP endpoint. Validated and written to a protected endpoint file; the gateway receives the file path only.

modbus_tcp_dial_timeout.description: Scalar Modbus dial timeout. Validated in the helper; a nonempty endpoint list requires this scalar to retain its default.

modbus_tcp_endpoints.description: Optional endpoint list. The helper validates and materializes one protected document; the gateway receives only its path.

m2m_graphql_enabled.description: Enable the dedicated TLS GraphQL listener and validate its fixed TLS files. The optional Portal client bundle enables additional Portal arguments only when complete.

m2m_graphql_server_name.description: TLS server identity, validated before startup; also supplied to the optional Portal client.

m2m_graphql_asset_ref.description: Opaque allowed asset reference; also supplied to the optional Portal client.

growatt_bms_rs485_asset_id.description: Required opaque asset identity, distinct from source identity.

growatt_bms_rs485_source_id.description: Required opaque source identity, distinct from asset identity.

growatt_bms_rs485_source_epoch.description: Required opaque source epoch label when the family is enabled.

growatt_bms_rs485_unit_id.description: Required routed unit number from 1 through 247.

growatt_bms_rs485_parity.description: Serial parity: none, even or odd.

growatt_bms_rs485_response_timeout.description: Positive response timeout in milliseconds or seconds.

growatt_bms_rs485_max_response_delay.description: Positive maximum response delay in milliseconds or seconds.

growatt_bms_rs485_max_quiescence.description: Positive quiescence duration, greater than the response delay.

growatt_bms_can_enabled.description: Enable this family; disabled families emit no arguments.

growatt_bms_can_interface.description: One interface name validated by the helper; enabled CAN families require distinct interfaces.

growatt_bms_can_listen_only_confirmed.description: Record the external listen-only precondition; must be true when enabled. The helper does not configure or verify controller mode.

modbus_materialization.text:
def materialize(config: Config, path: Path) -> None:
    """Write the endpoints document atomically: mode 0600 in a 0700 directory, staged then renamed."""
    if not config.endpoints:
        raise ConfigError("no endpoint list")
    body = endpoints_document(config.endpoints)
    directory = path.parent
    directory.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    os.chmod(directory, 0o700)
    staging = _staging(path)
    _remove(staging)
    flags = os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | getattr(os, "O_NOFOLLOW", 0)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(os.open(staging, flags, 0o600), "wb") as handle:
            os.fchmod(handle.fileno(), 0o600)
            handle.write(body)
        os.replace(staging, path)
    except BaseException:
        _remove(staging)
        raise

def _validate_command(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    config = load_config(args.options)
    print(_shell_assignment("MODBUS_TCP_ENABLED", str(config.enabled).lower()))
    print(_shell_assignment("MODBUS_TCP_ENDPOINT", config.endpoint))
    print(_shell_assignment("MODBUS_TCP_DIAL_TIMEOUT", config.dial_timeout))
    if config.endpoints:
        print(_shell_assignment("MODBUS_TCP_CONFIG", "v2"))
    return 0
